description: The app's statistics (the panel's Statistics tab), kept only while `playerStats` is on (off by default; turn it on with neblla_update_app playerStats: true, in the act; it costs quota). The last `days` UTC days (30 by default), today included, of signed-in players: `cards` { activeToday, activeYesterday, activeThisWeek, activeLastWeek, weekTrend (% vs the week before), dailyActiveAvg7, dailyActiveTrend, newPlayers, newTrend (% vs the period before), visits, avgMinutesPerDay (per active player and day, with the app open and in sight), avgMinutesPerVisit, returns { d1, d7, d30: { cohort, returned, rate } }, money { currency: minor units } }, `series` (one point a day: active, new, visits, minutes, avgMinutes, money), `weeks` (the last six: active, new, money; the last one partial), `sources` and `campaigns` (where new players' first visit came from: utm_source, else the referrer's host, else "direct"; "neblla" = the gallery), `products` (sales and money per product), `bookings` (with booking sets: occupancy per set and per class and time, weekday 0 = Monday, in `timeZone`) and `cost`: what keeping them costs from the visits of now { visitsPerDay, basis, creditsPerDay, dailyQuota, percentOfDailyQuota, eurosPerDay, eurosPerMonth } — ask for it before turning them on. `on` false: nothing is being kept (rows from before may still show). format "csv": { csv, filename }, one row a day. Reading costs the app's quota like a read of its tables.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the classes' times (default UTC; the days are UTC)

name: neblla_get_stats
title: Get stats
